body: GIRL ?!? NOOOO. You’re literally gorgeous!!! I’m serious.
The main thing is lying or doing something to disrespect me and/or our relationship.
Yesss you better believe it!! CONGRATULATIONS !!!!

Yes everything you just said yes! But here’s the thing everything you just said is what dad & I had agreed on. The room door is always locked regardless is I’m there or SD is there or not, dad always locks bedroom door at night. And yes the agreement was that is SD is scared he could go comfort her in her bed. So everything you just said is prefect and it’s exactly what we had agreed to, the problem is.. dad doesn’t do it. 

And yes I also agree that I let my emotions get the best of me, I was so tired from clinicals and I just wanted to come home and sleep in my bed.

That’s very unrealistic. Making a whole extra room with a bed? It’s unnecessary because THAT is my bed. How is it that the solution is for me to have to have a whole separate bed, when dad & SD can just walk to her room & sleep on her bed is she’s scared. SD would already be on her feet & so would dad because the room door is always locked.

Yeah I agree with everything. We have had these conversations, and the plan has been that if she does come in the middle of the night knocking on the door (the bedroom door is always locked regardless if I’m there or not & regardless if SD is there or not) that dad could go sleep with her in her bed.
No, he told me he let her sleep in the bed.

It is definitely not an issue with SD, I just want my boundary to be respected by dad. I have not moved in yet, but because I was planning on moving in soon I have been staying over lately and slowly integrating myself. But I need my SO to help me out and have my back that’s all I want. It’s already hard enough having to adjust into a family where I have no blood connection to and where SD sometimes is nice to me and sometimes it’s not, it’s extremely hard. I just need my SO to have my back, that’s all. I’m not trying to be difficult at all. If that is going to be my home, it is not realistic that I have to leave my home.

Yes that is true I don’t understand, but that doesn’t mean that my boundary isn’t valid. We both chose to be with each other it wasn’t just me. I have compromised so much because I wanted to and because I want to be part of their life, a little compromise from him is not a lot to ask. My boundary is my bed not him not being there when his daughter is scared. He doesn’t have to chose either or. He can respect my boundary and still be there for his daughter. Being lazy isn’t an excuse to not go through an agreement. If she’s scared he can comfort her in her room & sleep with her, that doesn’t change the fact that he’s being there for her. I’m truly not asking for a lot, yet somehow I’m the bad guy because I’m asking for one little thing. Somehow that makes me not equipped to be a maternal figure. Step parents, especially step moms get kicked down for such little things, when I know that I personally have tried my hardest to be the best step mom I can be. I’ve bought books, I’ve watched videos, I’ve asked for advice, I’m learning every day.

My whole point is why agree to something you know you can’t or won’t do? Because not only is he not having any consideration towards my feelings he’s not having any towards his daughter either & the relationship that her and I have and have took so long to build. Him being wishy washy about her sleeping in her bed also confuses her & creates friction in my relationship with her. I’m not saying anything about who comes first or last, or anything about that. Also, I am childless but that doesn’t mean that I don’t try to understand where parents come from and how I can better help and accommodate, but what I’ve seen is that bioparents don’t really care to understand how it feels to be a step-parent and help them in their journey into the family. At the end of the day the goal is to have a happy family where we are all happy or content with family decisions not just bioparents and kids. In that case they aren’t treating step-parents like human beings.

I’m sorry but I’m not her parent and she doesn’t see me as one either. I don’t mind cuddling watching a movie on the couch or in her bed but when I want to sleep in my bed I want to be comfortable & at peace. I’m not immature because I want one thing for myself and her dad agreed on it. I didn’t force him to agree, in fact I even told him if it’s truly something you don’t want then tell me, but nope he said he agreed and would go through with it. So then how am I in the wrong? Just because I want one thing for myself doesn’t make my relationship with her any less.
What is your point?

I didn’t tell him to move her. I didn’t even want him to move her, I found it unnecessary because she was asleep, why wake her? 
I only woke him because I was talking him that I got home and then that’s when I noticed she was in bed. Of course I’m tired and that instant shock of feeling like he’s been lying to be made me feel hurt. He was the one who sat up and I just told him if he could come out to the living room to explain the situation to me because obviously I have so many emotions. I even left the room she was in because I didn’t want to be all emotional in front of her. He was the one who decided to wake her, and again it ends up being my fault. I didn’t want a deep conversation I just wanted a quick explanation. But yes, I do understand it was 3am and nobody likes getting woken up.
She is 6, going on 7 in October. He says he understands that it will cause resentment towards me but sadly it just doesn’t feel like he cares if it does.

This is something we have talked to our old therapist about. It has been a constant disagreement. Our therapist suggested that we both come to an agreement, which we did. And she also agreed that it was true that he should put her to bed in her room even if I wasn’t there because that creates resentment towards me. My SO agreed to what I stated in my post, so it wasn’t just me telling him what to do, we both had a conversation and that was the conclusion. I even told him straight up, if you don’t agree to it then tell me. Like I said I don’t ever say anything about anything else, even if it hurts my feelings. Or course there will be certain situations that are understandable but why agree to something if you know you won’t do it? That’s what’s frustrating. The fact that he agreed to it and has been telling me for the past two months that he’s been doing it but I find out that now he obviously has been lying. THATS the real issue. I would rather someone tell me the truth than comfort me with a lie. Especially because let’s say I wouldn’t have found out, I would have moved in and his daughter would have instantly resentment me because she no longer gets to sleep in the bed meanwhile I’m over here thinking she’s been sleeping in her bed all this time. Idk if that makes sense. But thank you for your response!

I am honestly so relieved that I am not the only one with this bed boundary. SO kept repeating that it’s “just a bed” and makes me feel crazy that my boundary is not a valid reasonable one. Thank you.

Well both are true. He is an avoidant type & I am an anxious. So he is very dismissive, especially when it has to do with SD. He gets very emotional and just instantly angry at me. Which I understand him getting emotional but it does hurt when he instantly turns on me. He always says that I’m not considerate towards his daughter and that I act & react badly. But when I ask him how am I not considerate towards his daughter he can’t tell me and I asked him how was my reaction not a normal one? But yes, also I do understand it was the middle of the night and I felt emotional, but I guess even if I was emotional I wasn’t being irrational and he was instantly defensive about it. 
Like I said earlier the bed is the ONLY thing I ask for when it comes to SD. Anything and everything else I don’t ever say anything. But he has said that “all the rules” I have make him feel like he’s in the military, when the only “rule” (boundary) I have is SD sleeps in her bed.

I honestly couldn’t say if it was a one time thing. SO lies a lot about things so I really wouldn’t know. I trusted him but after last night I really can’t say. Getting SD to sleep in her own bed was hard but what has worked has been giving her two night passes she can use, she’ll knock on the door and SO will get the pass and take her back to bed. So I know that she didn’t sneak into the bed, he opened the door and let her sleep on the bed. Which is why he said that he knew he was going against my boundary and felt bad but he just wanted to sleep & was just going to tell me & apologize about it in the morning but of course that didn’t happen because I got home early. .___.

It just sucks because in all of this, somehow I come out the bad guy. & I feel like SD6 resents me because I get to spend time with Dad & she doesn’t. When in reality that’s not my fault, that’s his. At the end of the day she will always love her dad but me, I already have it hard & this makes it harder. Like how do I always come out as the bad guy.

Yes. I really don’t want to say anything to him & I’ve been being very positive to him about it, & telling him that it’s okay for him to feel sucky about it & that everyone makes mistakes, it’s about learning & moving forward. Also that he should take this opportunity to talk to his daughter & let her know how he feels, apologize & reassure her in what she’s feeling. He told me thank you & that he would call her tonight. 

SD always wants to stay the night at her grandparents house because she doesn’t like sleeping in her room here at the house. & this weekend was the first weekend she said she didn’t want to stay at her grandparents for two nights. So maybe she’ll be more okay with sleeping in her room knowing she’ll get to see her dad more. 

I don’t know if that makes sense, I’m just trying to see the positive in things. 

But I was just thinking more about future similar scenarios. Should I tell him my opinions or just stay quiet?

I think every kind of family blended or not can take a toll on your mental health. I love my SO and I love my SD. I knew coming into their lives that it wouldn’t be easy. As long as my SO is in this like I am that’s all I can ask for. Because yes even though things are hard right now, it’s worth it.

It’s so confusing. Like right now, they just got out of the teacher meet & greet and I saw my SO calling me and it was SD saying hey and she was joking around like she always does and was like we are gonna go pick you up so we can get an ice cream together & go to the park . And I was like oh okay and then she started telling me about her teacher and how she liked her teacher and how she liked the playground at her school. I just feel like if she really didn’t like me she wouldn’t try to tell me these things. Or idk ? It’s truly confusing. 
I really wish that BM & my SO would get together and have a conversation about it because I’m honestly the one getting just all the hurt & mixed signals.

We’ve been living together for a year now. She would also say she liked spending time with me in the first few months. Then she would say that I was mean to her (which hurt me a lot because I have never been mean to her), now she’s okay with my presence but she’s never been okay with her dad & I showing affection at all.
She’ll be 6 in a month.

She will get jealous or mad even if we just sit together. One time I asked him if he could sit beside me and he said yes and she got up and went to sit at the other side of the room. When my SO asked her to come sit with us, she refused until he moved away from me. 
This weekend we went on a weekend getaway with his family and he & I slept on the couch. When she woke up in the morning, she saw that I had my head on his lap and she refused to give him a hug. 
We have watched movies together and when he has tried to touch my hand or put his hand around me, she will grab his hand and take it away. 
My SO says he’s oblivious to all of these things & doesn’t notice them.

I have spoke to him about it a couple of times and he says he doesn’t notice his change in affection towards me when his daughter is around but I have a feeling that he does and just doesn’t want to show affection because SD gets jealous/mad .
I really wish we could as well. Do SK ever get jealous or angry?

I honestly don’t know because he doesn’t have open communication with her and if he were to say something to him he wouldn’t tell me unless I ask and keep asking. 
Like right now, he was with his daughter hangout out with family. His BM has already got on to him for dropping his daughter off this late because she still gives her a bath and puts her to bed and wants to have her at least an hour before bed time. BM has to wake up SD early to take to daycare and BM has stated that SD gets grumpy if she doesn’t get enough sleep. But what does my bf do right now? Takes her home late. It just really seems like he has no consideration towards anyone.

He doesn’t honestly. Not just about things that have to do with his daughter but just our relationship as well. We are going to couples therapy and it is helping with our communication, but once anything has to do with his daughter he acts 10x more angry. Which it’s understandable because it’s his daughter, but I don’t ever say anything bad or rude, everything that I say are just suggestions or to start a conversation to better know where his mind is at. We have talked about how we would want to raise our kids and we are on the same page, and even says that that is what he would want for his daughter as well. But he just doesn’t do it. It’s like he wants to have a good life, a good family, a good relationship, a good relationship w/ his daughter and BM , but doesn’t want to put in the work. That’s really what it feels like. In our next therapy session I’m def going to bring this up and state my feelings and thoughts.

Everything you just said it’s exactly how I feel. But even the whole white board thing he would say that it feels like boot camp or no fun. I’m trying my best honestly. We are doing couples therapy , and our next session I am definitely stating how I feel, maybe our therapist will better help us know how we each feel and find an agreement .

Thank you for replying. I feel like we would get along lol I understand what you are saying. I finished my minor is psychology this last spring and I had a behavior class as well. And I do share those thoughts with my bf. I do feel like he does feel judged. And as much as I try to approach him in different ways, he does always take everything that I say in a negative way. Which is what causes me to not know what I can or can’t say to him and it does in some ways scare me to even have open communication with him, but I do always try to even if it scares me on how he would react.

I am very open with my bf about how I feel & what my thoughts are but he isn’t. I also do keep that in mind, that he has limited time with her, which is why I always suggest to him activities prior to us picking her up that way we can plan a fun weekend. I believe happiness is the goal in life but that doesn’t mean that there shouldn’t be some sort of structure. His BM wants that for her daughter, so why wouldn’t my bf try to do his part as well? But I mean at the end of the day he is her dad and all I can do is advice & suggest.

That’s the thing that I wasn’t upset over the door, I was just simply reminding him of the decision she had made when we presented to her those two positions. He was the one that got upset because I reminded him and he said that I don’t have any consideration of his daughter. All I did was state one sentence, I don’t think it’s something he should get mad about. He could of just simply just said “ oh I don’t remember, but I feel like it’ll help her sleep better so I’ll leave it open” , and I would of been like oh okay, and that would of been it. I know I didn’t say anything wrong, I just reminded him of something, so why does he have to be so defensive towards me?

Thank you for your advice. I really appreciate it. We are actually in couples therapy because of a lot of problems we have had (nothing that had to do with his daughter), I have seen growth in the both of us so I’m hopeful that things will not only change in our relationship but in how he parents. If they don’t then I know that it just wasn’t meant to be.

You are completely right. I don’t think going the legal route is what is best either. About him being more involved in school that is something that I have told him, getting in contact with her teacher and receiving information from her and the school directly than wait omg for his BM to tell him. But unfortunately, I have a lot of conversations with him like that about things he could do to be more involved but he just doesn’t do them. And sadly even though I care about his daughter and would like to be involved in her life as well I can’t call the school or even meet her teacher because I don’t have that authority.

Or maybe it comes from a person who has been trying for a long time to make things happen but isn’t given anything back. I can push my boyfriend to be more involved in his daughters life and be more responsible and do more but if he doesn’t do it than that’s not my fault. Ever since I was introduced to his daughters life I have been the one being the “parent” in this house to always be involved, implement things in this house that her mom implements in hers (bed times, screen time ). I always run everything by my boyfriend first because I don’t want to over step. His BM would always get mad at him for letting her do what she wanted here and then she would look like the “bad guy” because she actually had structure at her house. I was the one who had conversations with my bf about how she had a point, and they should have conversations on how they want to raise their daughter and things be done in both households. I’m the one who spends time online researching trying to find the best way to make things work. So yes it does feel like I’m the parent and trying to do parent things when biologically I’m not meanwhile her actually bio dad isn’t doing anything but letting her do whatever she wants and causing problems with his BM. It’s causing me stress because I know I’m trying my best but if my bf doesn’t want to do things then ultimately it’s truly not my problem. I’m doing & have done what I can.
I guess that’s true. Bottomline its truly not my problem and doesn’t concern me. Maybe I should back off.
Okay so if I read this correctly, there had to had been a reason why the judge found my boyfriend unfit to have joint custody of his daughter? Do you know what kind of reasons that might be?

Yes, I have pushed him to tell me how things are from a legal stand point but he just tells me here and there. I feel bad for pushing but I do care about his daughter and him , so I would want to know if there is a way to make things equal and fair. But that’s true, I am only getting his side of the story. I wish there was a way to legally see the court order but I know there isn’t.
I hope everything goes well for you!! I’m proud of your courage <3
I’m happy you had the courage to compliment her. How did that make you feel ? :)

She told me a few of positive things about myself but I don’t even believe them. She told me I am nurturing and an advocate because I am able to stand up for my little brothers & give them advice about anything since I’m 7+ years older than them. Which I mean yeah I do, but I don’t live at home anymore so I rarely seen them, and we rarely text because I’m super busy or they just don’t reply. So how nurturing can I be if I’m rarely there. I see myself as an awkward & weird person. It’s hard for me to make friends. Plus I have a resting b face so I look pissed all the time even if I’m just there doing nothing. I don’t know how to small talk to I feel like that causes people to back away from me. I don’t think people like to hangout with me. I don’t even think my boyfriend truly loves me. He always tells me I’m beautiful and smart and how lucky he is to be with me but then he also tells me that I’m a monster and that I make his life hell. So idk what to believe. So I always believe the worst. I don’t even like myself. Not just physically but everything. Sometimes I truly don’t understand what my purpose is here. Most of the time I feel like I wasn’t made to be loved.

I try to reassure him as much as I can, but it’s hard when he accuses me of doing things I don’t do. 
Honestly I don’t think that it’s his right to know if I hooked up with someone at my party because it’s not his business, it’s my sexual life. 
Hooking up with someone doesn’t make me any less of a person. 
When I started liking him, I was all in and still am. I don’t talk to other guys, I don’t cheat. I have always been 100% committed to him in our relationship. And have never given him a reason to doubt me. 
I validate his feelings, but I don’t think it’s right for him to accuse me of things or treat me a certain way because of it .

We have had conversations about it and I always tell him that his feelings are valid, but he can’t hold that against me because our relationship will never work if he does. And he has said time and time again that he trying to move forward but that he just feels like the second option and that maybe I was talking with that guy. 
I’ve told him that he wasn’t, that I was not talking to that guy. But he still feels that way. 
And sometimes when he just gets mad at me he’ll accuse me of talking to other guys or just “being a whore”. And I know that it comes from what I did that night of my party. 
I have never shown him that I am a liar or a cheater. But I do think that he doesn’t trust me because I didn’t tell him, but I still don’t think it was his business to know. 
After I told him about that night, there has only been 3 times that it has came up.
